Buyer Added Bid Specific ATC Buyer Added text based ATC clauses PR NO : 1006096025 Note: Only Designer Recommended Source are eligible to participate in tender. 1.(a) The item SUSTAINER NOZZLE BLANK to be manufactured & Supplied by the vendor as per Manufactu ring Document and Drawings(with latest amendments wherever applicable). (b) The document is enclosed as Manufacturing Document for Nozzle Closures, Document No: DRDO/DRDL- ASL/HN/PROP/05B, Rev 0, Issue:01. (c) The required input material /Raw material for manufacturing is under vendor scope. Vendor should carr y out all the raw material testing's as per QAP for PUF Blocks Document. (d) The components to Machined as per drawing. After machining, Inspection/Testing to be carried out by t he vendor as per Drawing and Document. (e) After machining, NDT i.e. Radiography to be carried out as per document which is under vendor scope. (f) Burst Test should be carried out as per document which is under BDL scope. The clearance of the Batch /lot will be given only after satisfactory Burst Test Results. 2. The components should be free from burrs, cracks, damages & Peel off. 3.(a)Inspection agency: Inspection agency is BDL / MSQAA or their nominated inspection agency. (b)All the supplies should accompany with all the relevant inspection/test reports of the items cleared by t he inspection agency. (c)Final acceptance after receipt of the items at BDL stores along with I-Note/Green Card of MSQAA or their nominated inspection agency. 4. Vendor shall inform BDL and MSQAA at various stages as per QA matrix prior One Week to review/witne ss and give clearance for further processing. 5.(a) All documents /drawings supplied along with this tender are the property of DRDO and 100% IPR is he ld with DRDO. These documents/drawings shall not be used for any other purpose, not to be disclosed, cop ied and revised in any form without the permission of RCI (DRDO). (b) Non-Disclosure Agreement (NDA) in the given format shall be entered in to signed & submitted by the vendor. 6. Pre-Dispatch Inspection (PDI): (a) Vendor has to intimate for PDI one week in advance before delivery to BDL. (b) PDI will be carried out at manufacturer's/Vendor's place. (c) The items shall be dispatched to BDL only after pre-dispatch inspection (PDI) by BDL/MSQAA/BDL Inspe ction agency (or) Waiver to PDI issued by BDL. 7. Delivery Term: The items shall be delivered at BDL stores and free delivery to BDL (F.O.R. BDL, Kancha nbagh, Hyderabad). 8. Replacement for the rejected items shall be provided on Priority basis at free of cost. 9. Delivery schedule:-Total Order Quantity shall be supplied within 03 months from the date of receipt of M SQAA vetted purchase order (PO). 10.(a) The equipment used for special fabrication process like furnaces, thermocouples, pressure gauges e tc shall have valid calibration certificate.

(b)All the measuring instruments/ gauges shall have valid calibration certificate and shall be produced to i nspection agency of BDL on demand. (c) The Tools, Jigs & Fixtures, Mandrels, etc, used for fabrication are under vendor scope. 11.(a) All the Items shall be marked by engraving/labeling/ providing tag to ensure identification of compo nent/ heat cycle during and after fabrication. (b)Engraving shall be done at the location marked/shown as in the drawing. For other components, don’t h ave engraving location, shall be tagged/labeled with their identification number. 12. Complete inspection and documentation shall be carried out and maintained by the manufacturer as p er drawings and QT plan document. 13. Payment terms: 100% Payment within 30 days after receipt & acceptance of material at BDL stores. 14. LD Clause: Time is the essence of the P.O and delivery should be strictly insisted upon according to the delivery schedule given in the SOs/POs. In the event the supplier fails to deliver the goods / service, within the stipulated delivery period, BDL reserves the right to recover from the supplier, LD and not by way of p enalty an amount as detailed in terms and conditions. A sum of 0.5% of the price only of the stores (Includi ng duties, taxes) which the supplier has failed to deliver as aforesaid for each week of delay or part thereof , subject to a maximum of 10%. In case of extension of delivery period, increase in taxes shall not be borne by BDL, if delay is attributable to vendor. 15. Benefit of ITC Clause: (a) Benefit of Input Tax Credit should be passed on to BDL without fail. (b) Benefit of reduction in rate of GST applicable for the supply, compared to the rate of GST as per the Co ntract, should be passed on to BDL without fail. (c) A Certificate duly signed by the Company Secretary/ Director/ CFO/ Managing partner/ Proprietor, as th e case may be, should be furnished along with the quotation in the following format. "Certified that the be nefit of input tax credit and /or rate reduction has been duly and commensurately passed on in terms of se ction 171 of the CGST Act." 16. The Successful bidder will be debarred / blacklisted for the future tenders for a period as decided by B DL, if the bidder deviates from the agreed terms & conditions after the award of Purchase Order / Work Order / Servi ce Order apart from forfeiture of your EMD. 17. GST Clause: "BDL reserves its right to release GST only after supplier's invoice/debit note is reflected in GSTR-2B/2A within the specified time limit mentioned in GST law". 18. Supplier shall not supply non-conforming product against specification. 19. In case of non-conformity product, supplier has to inform BDL for further disposition action (i.e.re-work, rejection etc.). 20. Supplier shall retain the product related records (Processes, Quality Records etc.,) up to 3years. 21. BDL, its customer and regulatory authorities having right of access to the applicable areas of all your fa cilities, at any level of supply chain, involved in our order and all applicable records. 22. Supplier shall ensure that the persons carrying out the manufacturing of items under this purchase ord er be aware of Product conformity requirements, Product safety and Importance of ethical behavior etc., 23. Supplier shall notify to BDL in case of suspected/detected Counterfeit parts (if any) during any stage of manufacturing for its prevention of further use and quarantine of the same. 24. All Other Terms & conditions are applicable as per the General / Limited Terms and conditions attached . 25. It may be noted whenever special conditions are listed above; the same supersedes the conditions men tioned in General/Limited Terms & Conditions.###
